coupling: The earlier lossless-window commit changes VP8LGetWindowRows from a doubled allocation to a minimum row count, while keeping lossless allocations doubled in GetWindowRows. The later alpha-window commit reduces its history allowance to four rows. With either edit alone, the alpha window still holds the decode batch in the probe. Combined, the alpha caller allocates only the reduced minimum, and ExtractAlphaRows writes a batch past the end of the allocation. Repair requires checking the shared sizing contract against the alpha consumer and preserving enough rows for its largest batch.
